content: Theiburbil kasaal ngai chongtekak

Khan Jesu ning anmanideng chongtekak ngai aleirilpe: <<Pha inkhat a theiburbil kiling mi inkhat aleiom, theiburbil sarapal aleikhar, theibur musorna sik khur inkhat aleichei, khanna berte inkhat aleibol, Khan atheiburbil kha akotho ngaideng asaljei khana a-inn amusoli khomol asejei.
Theibur khekpha kha ahongtung pha, amaning asok inkhat theiburbil kasaal ngaideng asaal kalei sik aleitir.
Theiburbil kasaal ngai khaning asuokpa kha ansurra anleirachak, inkhatte palei a antir je.
Khan theiburbil kupu khaning asok lop inkhat atir nok, theiburbil kasaal ngai khaning alu anlei rachak a kinjak anleipe.
Akupu khaning suok lop inkhat atir nok, khan anmani ning amakha anlei that jei; khanna alak katam tak num kha-angkhan anlei tho jei, alekning anlei rachak, alekning an leithat jei.
Tir sik-a inkhat bei akaom khachu asapa mirittak kha e, Atorna tak a asapa kha theiburbil kasaal ngai deng atir jei. Amaning aleiti, <Kasapa hichu anmani ning anlei kaja nger sik tia kikin ngam.>
Takkha theiburbil kasaal ngai khaning inkhat le inkhat anlei kinbek, <Amahi theiburbil kupupa sapa e. Hongru that ri, khanna amaning phasik rikip hi einita achang sik jei!> anti
Khawa jarra anmani ning sapa kha ansurra anthat je khanna akithi kha theiburbil ralteng andengjon jei.

<<Kha achang inchu theiburbil kupupa khaning angmo atho sik jei?>> tia Jesu ning aleirakal. <<Ama ahong sik khan theiburbil kasaal ngaikha athat sik je khanna theiburbil kha milop deng aminsaal nok sik jei.
Akidik tak a hiwa chongkintheng hi nin leipa sik je?>>

content.text: << <Inn kasak ngai ning thamakjei tia andengjon lungkha
Hiwa hi Puma ning atho e;
Eini mit mu-a kho-ongtuk a akinlak mi!> >>

content: Jehudi lamkakei ngai khaning Jesu sur sik a anlei kin thok e, ajarchu amaning chongtekak aleitho ngai kha anmani chung nga aril e ti hi anleijet. Takkha anmani ning mipui ngaikha anleichi, khawa jarra amakha anlei mathaanli anse jei.
Ramsel pesik chungchanga rakalna
Jesu deng chong anrakalli surna sik a, Pharisees alek le Herod mingai alek amadeng aleitir.

Anmanining amadeng anhonga anleiti, <<Oja nangning mingai modonna inkhatte chilei-a akidik niril hi kinjet. Nangning atute mai enmak che, takkha mingai sik-a Pathien lungdo kha akidik a nalei minchu. Khanna Caesar denga ramsel pesik hi eini Dan akoi mi? Nipe sik mi? Nipe mak sik mi?>>
Takkha Jesu ning anmani changkam kha ajet a aleimasang, <<Angsik mo kei niminkhit sik niti e? Roman sumsan inkhat kha heichoi ru, khan keining enkate.>>
Anmanining sumsan inkhat anhei choi, khan amaning aleirakal, <<Tu milim le riming mo akinje e?>> <<Caesar>> tia anleimasang.
Jesu ning aleiti, <<Caesar takha Caesar peru, khan Pathien takha Pathien deng peru.>> Khana anmani ning Jesu kha anleingak je.
Thi ria ringnok chungchanga rakalna
Khan Sadducee alekning, miring hi thi ria ring noning je akiti ngai, Jesu deng anhonga anleiti,

<<Oja, Moses ning hiwa dan hi keini sik-a aleimije: <Mi inkhat athi-a naite neilei-a anumei aleida inchu, anaipa inkhatning churmeinu kha aom pui nger sik, khawa jarra anmani inni annei naite ngai kha akithipa naite e tia anlei thei nasik e.>
Pha inkhat a unai sari anlei om; upa tak khaning numei anei je khana naite neilei-a athi je.
Khan inni changnapa khaning numei kha aom puinok je, ama khanum naite nei lei-a athi nok je. Khanna inthum changnapa annaipa khanum kha-ang tit a asuok nok je,
khana alak ngaiseng: unai sari khaning num numei nu kha an ompui rip a naite nei lei-a anthi rip je. Atorna tak a, numei nu khanum athi je.
Atunchu, akithi rikip ringnok ning nikho khan khawanu kha atu numei mo achang sik e? Anmani sari ning numeinu kha an lei ompui rip.>>
Jesu ning anmanideng aleimasang, <<Kho-ongtuk a nintho thel ije! Khana angsik jar mi ti hi ninjet mi? Hiwa hi nangni ning chongkintheng le Pathien ranak kha ninjet mak jarra e.
Ajarchu akithi ngai kha anringnok pha, anmani ngai kha marwan tirle kupo anchang sik jei khan innei omno ning jei.

Atunchu, akithi ngai anthei sik jarra: Moses jedet rubu a thingbur meikachoong chong akinje kha pangai lei mo nin e? Khawa khan hi-ang akinje tichu Pathien ning Moses deng, <Kei Abraham Pathien, Isaac Pathien, khanna Jacob Pathien ki-e,> ati.
Amahi akiring ngai Pathien e, akithi ngai Pathien imak. Nangni ninthel rangra jei!>>
Chongpena koloktak

Dan oja inkhat ahong a anmani ankinbek kha alei rangai. Jesu ning Sadducees ngai deng chong katha masang kha aleimu. Khawa jarra akolla ahonga chong aleirakal: <<Chongpena karra kho khamo akolok tak e?>>
Jesu ning aleimasang, << <Israel ngai rangai ru! Puma eini Pathien bei kha e ni Puma.
Puma ni Pathien kha numulung pumpui, naratha pumpui a, nimindonna pumpui, khanna naranak ratna pumpui ning minreng ro.>
Khanna inni changna chongpena koloktak khachu: <Nang nabinga nikinreng anga nokho niweng minreng ro.> Hiwa inni ngai kikhella chongpena kolok alop om-mak.>>
Dan oja khaning Jesu deng aleiril, <<Oja! Nangning akidik a niriljei, khachu Puma khabei e Pathien, ama ilei a alop Pathien ommak.

Khan Pathien kha numulung pumpui, nimindonna pumpui khan naranak ratna pumpui a minrengro, khan nibing a nikinreng anga nokho niweng minrengro, Hiwa chongpe inni kujui hining Pathien deng ran le kinthoina kapenek a mei a natak pumpui aro minkang nek a atha det.>>
Amaning kinsing thei tak a amasang kha Jesu ning amupha, amadeng aleiti, <<Nang Pathien Rengram ria akalak ommak che.>> Khanchu atute ning Jesu deng chong rakal tor muk jei.
Messiah chungchang rakalna
Jesu ning Bek-inn sunga aminchu lai, chong aleirakal,

content.text: <<Dan oja ngaining Messiah kha David sonlepar kha e tia kho-ongmo anti thei?
Ratha Kintheng ning David murtak a amin rilsuok:
Ninkin muda ngaikha nike thoi a kada mak kar seng
David khet ning amakha <Puma> tia akoi; achang inchu kho-ongmo Messiah kha David sonlepar achang thei sik?

content: >> Jesu ning dan Oja ngai renna (Mat 23:1-36; Lk 20:45-47) Khana mipui ngaining Jesu chong kha rokpui a anlei rangai.
Jesu ning anmani aminchu a anmanideng aleiril, <<Dan Oja ngai ri a kinsing thei ru, songkol kasei akinhak a akolon nom ngaikha keithella amin kajanom
khan synagogues le bak minchunna mun kahoitak khan akin ongnom.
Anmani ning Churmei ngai ria nemna an-entok khan insung neinak ngai anlei-leipe, mi musik a Pathien nina kosot tak a anleinei. Anmani kha karakna akakhel anpha sik!>>
Churmeinu sumsanpe
Jesu kha sumsan dana mudonna akin ong lai mipui ngai sumsan minbuk na pelom kosuok anpe kha a-enlai mikanei katamtak ngai ning sumsan akatampui anlei mata;
khan sara churmeinu inkhat num ahong a ana inni sumsan inkhat dam awothun minlut.
Jesu ning athiemroi ngai akoi mintup a anmanideng aleiril, <<keining akidik tak kinirilpe hiwa sara churmeinu ning sumsan minbukna akape ngai seng karra akatam akape kha e.
Ajarchu alop ngai seng khaning akatam annei na ria ankhoi then li anpe e, takkha hiwa nu ning asara chang aneiseng, aringna sik a aminbuk rikip kha ape e.>>

footnotes.text: Puma eini Pathien bei kha e ni Puma a-imakli Puma kha-e ei-ni Pathien, Puma inkhat bei-e.
